_comment: Whole-artifact STRIP decisions (CLAUDE.md §4.3 source of truth; design: FABLES_DECISIONS.md Suggestion 2). Layer boundary: whole CEs / whole maps / map events here; intra-event script-call strips live in the game's script-call reference table; command-code strips live in system.md. `static_predicates` = no-port feature *predicates* (code-111 script conditions) whose feature is not ported, so the condition is a compile-time constant; a branch conditioned exactly on the predicate emits the arm matching `value`, and the other arm is dropped as dead code (negated conditions invert). expect_name/expect_events are fail-loud assertions against re-export renumbering. `maps` = whole-map strips, honored by Phase-5 mint (the Phase-4 orchestrator reads only common_events + map_events). `map_events` entries accept EITHER shape: a bare 2-element `[map_id, event_id]` pair (back-compat, no reference note), or an object `{"map_id", "event_id", "expect_name", "feature", "reason"}` mirroring the `common_events` discipline — `expect_name` is the fail-loud renumbering guard, `feature`/`reason` record what the event was and why it's gone (and what would have to change to revisit it). Both shapes parse to the same (map_id, event_id) set; see `conversion_agent.orchestrator.load_map_event_strips` / `_parse_map_event_strip_entry`. Enforced by `tileset_converter.metadata_wiring.build_object_events` (drops before any graphics lookup) as well as the Phase-4 orchestrator.

static_predicates.feature: randomizer game mode (playthrough-wide species / moveset / type / wild-encounter shuffling; also gates nuzlocke_heal)
static_predicates.reason: No-port. Fork-verified 2026-07-21 (grep of engine/ include+src+config): pokeemerald-expansion ships NO randomizer or nuzlocke run-mode and no GetRandomPokemonSpecies analog — the 'randomiz' hits are all incidental (RNG primitive, AI switch-in, lottery/contest/TV). Supporting it would be a from-scratch subsystem with zero story weight. So `$PokemonGlobal.randomizer` is statically false in this port: a code-111 conditioned on it emits the else (normal) arm; the then (randomizer) arm is dropped as dead code (it is also unfillable — no random-species primitive exists). User-approved 2026-07-21. IMPLEMENTATION PENDING: transpiler does not yet read this (EV019's two randomizer branches are handled in the Map050_EV019.pory hand file today); the future static-predicate idiom in transpiler.py should consume this entry rather than hardcoding the string.

static_predicates.feature: 'Skip intro?' prompt on New Game (137__PScreen_Load.rb:840-844), offered only under $DEBUG or when a save file already exists; its arm in the intro (Map051 EV002) fast-forwards gender select, Running Shoes and switch 52 'Mum', then warps into the house
static_predicates.reason: No-port. A fresh game in this port always takes the full intro path, where talking to Auntie (map049/ev001/p0) is the only writer of switch 52 and the gate out of the house. Operator ruling 2026-09-25 (REDERIVATION_PLAN.md §16.3 ruling 14), which also removed C3's FlagSet(FLAG_MUM) new-game seed that had mirrored this arm.

static_predicates.feature: Pokerus infection check (any party Pokemon infected); Map068 EV001's healing-counter YES branch shows the Pokerus explanation on its then arm
static_predicates.reason: Deferred to CH18 (Nuclear Plant Epsilon, its home chapter), so no Pokemon in this port is ever infected and the check is statically false. Decision: CH03_TODO.md decision #4 update, 2026-08-14; the transpiler already emits only the else arm (`conversion_agent/transpiler.py` `_emit_pokerus_branch`, still hardcoded rather than reading this entry). Recorded here 2026-10-02 so the story model and beat generator see the same constant (ROM run 67: the generated nurse beat expected the then arm's text).

map_events.feature: RMXP ambient-lighting event (additive alpha-gradient glow overlay)
map_events.reason: No-port. Single page, trigger 0, empty command list, graphic `light` — one cell of an 800x800 sheet holding a soft alpha-gradient yellow glow circle. RMXP composites these as ADDITIVE light overlays; GBA 4bpp object graphics have no analogue — quantizing a smooth alpha gradient to 15 colours bands badly, and there is no additive blend mode. Carries no script and no gameplay, so it is dropped rather than faked. User-ruled 2026-08-05. Revisit only if the engine gains a real additive-glow blend path or a large-prop quantized-art substitute worth the art budget.

map_events.feature: RMXP ambient-lighting event (additive alpha-gradient glow overlay)
map_events.reason: Same event class and same disposition as map 33 EV028 above — the user's 2026-08-05 no-port ruling, applied to CH03's seven Kevlar Town lamp glows (2026-08-12). Each is byte-identical in shape to the Route-01 one: single page, trigger 0, one command, graphic `light`. The sprite pass fails loud on them (`light: content bbox 46x45 exceeds the 32x32 GBA object frame`), which is the same 800x800 sheet the ruling describes.
